# App Bridge 类型 {#app-bridge-types}

App Bridge 各页面用到的类型，以及它们引用的所有类型，均来自 [`@shopify/app-bridge-types`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@shopify/app-bridge-types) 0.7.4。`polaris-vue-elements/app-bridge` 重新导出该包所导出的类型。说明是 Shopify 自己的 JSDoc，保留英文。

## `ShopifyGlobal` {#shopifyglobal}

导入： `import type { ShopifyGlobal } from 'polaris-vue-elements/app-bridge'`

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `config` | <code v-pre><a href="/zh/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#appbridgeconfig">AppBridgeConfig</a></code> | 类型中没有说明。 |

| `setSignals()` | <code v-pre>(RealSignal: any) =&gt; void</code> | Registers a signals implementation (e.g. from `@preact/signals`) so that reactive values returned by App Bridge use the app's own Signal class instead of the built-in lightweight shim. Any signals created before this call are migrated to the provided implementation. |
